reader_summary.overview: with David Mack, Joseph Okpaku, and Matt Spence How should startups engage with policymakers. Let alone explain their moves -- not just externally, but internally too? "We really viewed our first mission as education. Explaining what we were and, possibly more importantly, explaining what we weren't," shares Joseph Okpaku, vice president of government relations at Lyft.

key_points.text: with David Mack, Joseph Okpaku, and Matt Spence How should startups engage with policymakers.

not just in terms of making a first impression, but in terms of setting regulatory precedent (as well as in drawing a line).
